description: Structured eval definitions for the Backup Audit Automator. Five-case proven set exercising the AUTOMATION_DEPLOYED / REVIEW_REQUIRED classification across backup audit topologies (daily compliance report with SNS alerting, Vault Lock compliance mode verification, encryption audit for KMS coverage, multi-account Organizations report, missing S3 destination prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Daily backup compliance audit with SNS alerting and all report templates
eval_cases.branch: AUTOMATION_DEPLOYED — three report templates, S3 delivery, CIS/NIST frameworks, SNS failure alerts
eval_cases.prompt: Set up a daily backup compliance audit for my account 123456789012. I need all three report templates (BACKUP_JOB_REPORT, COMPLIANCE_REPORT, RECOVERY_POINT_REPORT) delivered to s3://backup-reports-bucket/reports/. Frameworks: CIS_AWS_1.4 and NIST_800_53. SNS alerts for backup failures to arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:backup-alerts.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BACKUP_AUDIT: daily-compliance-report
VERDICT: AUTOMATION_DEPLOYED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Report templates: BACKUP_JOB_REPORT, COMPLIANCE_REPORT, RECOVERY_POINT_REPORT
  [✓] S3 destination: s3://backup-reports-bucket/reports/
  [✓] Compliance framework: CIS_AWS_1.4, NIST_800_53
  [✓] SNS alerting: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:backup-alerts
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws backup list-report-plans

eval_cases.name: Vault Lock compliance mode verification with immutability check
eval_cases.branch: AUTOMATION_DEPLOYED — compliance mode (immutable) verified, 365-day retention, KMS encryption check
eval_cases.prompt: Audit my backup vault named compliant-vault. I need to verify it has Vault Lock in COMPLIANCE mode with 365-day retention. The vault must be immutable. Also check that all recovery points in this vault have KMS encryption.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BACKUP_AUDIT: vault-lock-verification
VERDICT: AUTOMATION_DEPLOYED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Vault Lock: compliant-vault — COMPLIANCE (immutable)
  [✓] Retention: 365 days
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws backup describe-backup-vault --backup-vault-name compliant-vault

eval_cases.name: Backup encryption audit for KMS coverage across all vaults
eval_cases.branch: AUTOMATION_DEPLOYED — encryption audit verifying KMS key on all recovery points
eval_cases.prompt: Run a backup encryption audit across all my backup vaults. I need to verify that every recovery point has KMS encryption. If any recovery points are unencrypted, flag them. S3 report delivery to s3://backup-audit-bucket/encryption/.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BACKUP_AUDIT: encryption-audit
VERDICT: AUTOMATION_DEPLOYED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Encryption audit: recovery points checked for KMS
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws backup list-recovery-points-by-backup-vault --backup-vault-name <vault>

eval_cases.name: Multi-account backup compliance report via AWS Organizations
eval_cases.branch: AUTOMATION_DEPLOYED — all accounts in Org, all regions, CIS framework, SNS alerts
eval_cases.prompt: Create an organization-wide backup compliance report. I need COMPLIANCE_REPORT delivered daily to s3://org-backup-reports/compliance/ covering ALL accounts in my Organization (5 accounts) and ALL regions. Framework: CIS_AWS_1.4. SNS alerts to arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:org-backup-alerts.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BACKUP_AUDIT: org-compliance-report
VERDICT: AUTOMATION_DEPLOYED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Multi-account: ALL_ACCOUNTS_IN_ORG (5 accounts)
  [✓] Compliance framework: CIS_AWS_1.4
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws backup list-report-plans

eval_cases.name: Backup report plan without S3 destination (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: REVIEW_REQUIRED — no S3 bucket for report delivery; report plans require S3 destination
eval_cases.prompt: Set up backup compliance reports. I do not have an S3 bucket for report delivery. Just create the report plan and figure out delivery later. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BACKUP_AUDIT: pending-report-plan
VERDICT: REVIEW_REQUIRED
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] S3 destination: MISSING — no S3 bucket for report delivery; report plans require an S3 destination with backup.amazonaws.com write permission
